test_title: PYST 177: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A dice is thrown three times. Its different positions are as shown. Select its next possible position from the given options.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af11d847df52572bd83013cebcf1a6a3e5ae54890e7a99658f947affd93ebdb0.png]
solution:
In first dice and second dice, A and B is common in both dice.

Moving dice1 in **anti-clockwise direction** the other adjacent side of A, B appeared is 'E'.

Moving again dice2 in anti-clockwise direction the other adjacent side of A,E appeared is 'F'.

Moving dice3 in anti-clockwise direction the other adjacent side of A, F will appear as 'C'.

As, from above three dices the opposite faces of give cube is as follows : 

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 **Opposite**
 
 

 A
 D
 
 

 B
 F
 
 

 C
 E
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be49d3e820b9d84b2e7dc63a06385024e68f57ba303198642869e84dbd424063.png] 

∴ Here, the next possible position will be A, F adjacent with side 'C'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
